title: Walking SALURBAL-Climate Proposal
text:
2.1 Global walking
Global walking levels differed across countries. Median walking was higher in Mexico and El Salvador and lower in Colombia and Guatemala. Greater variability was observed in Mexico and El Salvador, while extreme values were present in all countries. Histogram frequencies represent the number of individuals interviewed within each walking duration (min/week) interval.


Histogram global
dta %>%
  mutate(
    iso2 = recode(
      iso2,
      CO = "Colombia",
      GT = "Guatemala",
      SV = "El Salvador",
      MX = "Mexico"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = svypawalk)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 30,
    fill = "#4666A0",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~iso2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "\nGlobal walking (min/week)",
    y = "Frequency\n"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)











Boxplot global
dta %>%
  mutate(
    iso2 = recode(
      iso2,
      CO = "Colombia",
      GT = "Guatemala",
      SV = "El Salvador",
      MX = "Mexico"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = iso2, y = svypawalk, fill = iso2)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Colombia" = "#F0BF21",
      "Guatemala" = "#BCD5FF",
      "El Salvador" = "#303B56",
      "Mexico" = "#238179"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1500, by = 250)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Global walking (min/week) \n"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )

title: Walking SALURBAL-Climate Proposal
text:
8.1 Global walking


Model selection global
# Poisson
M0_global_pois <- glmmTMB(
  svypawalk ~
    ns(
      l1adtemp_pw_1_7_mean,
      knots = pred_knots_global
    ) +
    (1 | salid1),
  data = dta,
  family = poisson
)

# Negative binomial 1
M0_global_nb1 <- glmmTMB(
  svypawalk ~
    ns(
      l1adtemp_pw_1_7_mean,
      knots = pred_knots_global
    ) +
    (1 | salid1),
  data = dta,
  family = nbinom1
)

# Negative binomial 2
M0_global_nb2 <- glmmTMB(
  svypawalk ~
    ns(
      l1adtemp_pw_1_7_mean,
      knots = pred_knots_global
    ) +
    (1 | salid1),
  data = dta,
  family = nbinom2
)

# Zero-inflated Poisson
M0_global_zip <- glmmTMB(
  svypawalk ~
    ns(
      l1adtemp_pw_1_7_mean,
      knots = pred_knots_global
    ) +
    (1 | salid1),
  ziformula = ~1,
  data = dta,
  family = poisson
)

# Zero-inflated Negative Binomial 1
M0_global_zinb1 <- glmmTMB(
  svypawalk ~
    ns(
      l1adtemp_pw_1_7_mean,
      knots = pred_knots_global
    ) +
    (1 | salid1),
  ziformula = ~1,
  data = dta,
  family = nbinom1
)

# Zero-inflated Negative Binomial 2
M0_global_zinb2 <- glmmTMB(
  svypawalk ~
    ns(
      l1adtemp_pw_1_7_mean,
      knots = pred_knots_global
    ) +
    (1 | salid1),
  ziformula = ~1,
  data = dta,
  family = nbinom2
)

# Compare model fit
AIC(
  M0_global_pois,
  M0_global_nb1,
  M0_global_nb2,
  M0_global_zip,
  M0_global_zinb1,
  M0_global_zinb2
)

IRR table global
# Generate predictions across the full temperature range
pred_global <- ggpredict(
  M1_global_zinb2,
  terms = "l1adtemp_pw_1_7_mean [all]",
  bias_correction = TRUE
)

# Convert to data frame
pred_global_df <- as.data.frame(pred_global) %>%
  rename(
    temperature = x,
    predicted = predicted,
    lower = conf.low,
    upper = conf.high
  )

# Define reference temperature (25th percentile)
ref_temp <- pred_knots_global[[1]]
ref_index <- which.min(
  abs(pred_global_df$temperature - ref_temp)
)
ref_rate <- pred_global_df$predicted[ref_index]

# Calculate IRR
pred_global_df <- pred_global_df %>%
  mutate(
    IRR = predicted / ref_rate,
    IRR_low = lower / ref_rate,
    IRR_high = upper / ref_rate
  )

# Extract estimates at key percentiles
temps_interest <- as.numeric(pred_knots_global)
irr_global_table <- lapply(
  temps_interest,
  function(temp) {
    pred_global_df %>%
      slice(
        which.min(abs(temperature - temp))
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    percentile = c(
      "25th percentile",
      "75th percentile",
      "95th percentile"
    ),
    IRR_CI = paste0(
      round(IRR, 2),
      " (",
      round(IRR_low, 2),
      "; ",
      round(IRR_high, 2),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    percentile,
    temperature,
    IRR_CI
  )

IRR table transportation
pred_trn <- ggpredict(
  M1_trn_zinb2,
  terms = "l1adtemp_pw_1_7_mean [all]",
  bias_correction = TRUE
)
pred_trn_df <- as.data.frame(pred_trn) %>%
  rename(
    temperature = x,
    predicted = predicted,
    lower = conf.low,
    upper = conf.high
  )
ref_temp <- pred_knots_domain[[1]]
ref_index <- which.min(
  abs(pred_trn_df$temperature - ref_temp)
)
ref_rate <- pred_trn_df$predicted[ref_index]
pred_trn_df <- pred_trn_df %>%
  mutate(
    IRR = predicted / ref_rate,
    IRR_low = lower / ref_rate,
    IRR_high = upper / ref_rate
  )
temps_interest <- as.numeric(pred_knots_domain)
irr_trn_table <- lapply(
  temps_interest,
  function(temp) {
    pred_trn_df %>%
      slice(
        which.min(abs(temperature - temp))
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    percentile = c(
      "25th percentile",
      "75th percentile",
      "95th percentile"
    ),
    IRR_CI = paste0(
      round(IRR, 2),
      " (",
      round(IRR_low, 2),
      "; ",
      round(IRR_high, 2),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    percentile,
    temperature,
    IRR_CI
  )
